title: Silbert entities file Rule 144 notices on Zcash Trust shares
summary: Two Rule 144 notices, read directly from SEC EDGAR. Silbert Family Investments LLC filed on 5 Nov 2025 to sell 9,753 Grayscale Zcash Trust shares for $407,312.59, and Barry E. Silbert filed on 6 Nov to sell 1,000 shares for $47,250.00; both sales were on OTCQX. They sit inside a run of 148 Form 144 filings by DCG and Silbert entities between 24 Jan 2024 and 6 Nov 2025, clustered in consecutive-day runs that read as a programmatic disposal schedule.
body: These are ZCSH trust shares traded on OTCQX between investors. They move no ZEC on-chain, create no exchange inflow and add no ZEC sell pressure, and the research file says so in terms. The dossier's abridged timeline attaches the 9,753-share figure to Barry Silbert personally on 6 November at about $544 per ZEC; the EDGAR filings separate it, and the $544 is a ZEC price, not a share price, since 9,753 shares changed hands for $407,312.59, about $41.76 each. The juxtaposition worth stating, as fact and not as accusation, is that the same corporate family filing dozens of Rule 144 notices through 2024 and 2025 is the one whose unit is now discussing contributing roughly 200,000 ZEC to the converted trust, non-bindingly.
